title: Stage and apex specializations of cartesian open transport
statement: theorem perfect_hom_open_restriction_transport {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (B : Y.Opens) (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι) : (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (M Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj M ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q), perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE k.property))) a (perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk f) = perfectStageMap R (B.ι ≫ s) j.property hjk (perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))) a f)) ∧ (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (M Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj M ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q), perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (perfectLimitMap R c s j.property f) = perfectLimitMap R c (B.ι ≫ s) j.property (perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))) a f))

proof.text: Apply perfect_hom_open_transport_square with κ(r)=perfectHomOpenPullbackComparison s B r.hom a. Its required normalization is reflexivity by the concrete definition. Specialize the Over arrow to Spec.map(R.map(j≤k)) and Spec.map(c.ι_j), checking the Over conditions by functoriality and the cocone law.
